name: AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700

card.serve_args_note: fixed state backing: the default elastic backing runs a synchronous trim + compaction after every session end, which stalls the next long prefill; fixed backing commits the preset's pool_capacity eagerly, so the R9700 preset sizes the pool to the GPU (fixed_pool_capacity)

radeon-r9700.name: AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (gfx1201, 32 GB)
radeon-r9700.note: GDDR6 20 Gbps, 256-bit (640 GB/s peak), 32 GB; 64 CUs x 1024 x 2.92 GHz = 191 TFLOP/s dense f16 WMMA (AMD's spec). bw 613 GB/s measured on a DevLab R9700S

radeon-r9700s.name: AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700S (gfx1201, 32 GB, 2.35 GHz)
radeon-r9700s.note: The DevLab Dispatch radeon-r9700 runners are R9700S (same Navi 48 / 640 GB/s). Peak f16 WMMA measured there: 214 TFLOP/s (devlab-kbench gemm_r9700, #601)

pool_note: the board reports 31.86 GiB (34.2 GB) and the driver reserves part: loom-serve gets 34.0 GB, above the 33.2 GB the largest package that fits at its native context needs
